proof_body:
by
  intro ι s x m V hs hm hV
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < s.card := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Finset.card_pos.mpr hs)
  have hnn : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ (x i - m) ^ 2 := fun i _ => sq_nonneg _
  have h0 := Finset.sum_nonneg hnn
  constructor
  · rw [hV]
    exact div_nonneg h0 hn.le
  · rw [hV, div_eq_zero_iff, or_iff_left hn.ne', Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hnn]
    constructor
    · intro h i hi
      have h1 := pow_eq_zero_iff (two_ne_zero) |>.mp (h i hi)
      linarith
    · intro h i hi
      rw [h i hi]
      ring
target_source: ∀ (ι : Type*) (s : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) (m V : ℝ), s.Nonempty → m = (∑ i ∈ s, x i) / s.card → V = (∑ i ∈ s, (x i - m) ^ 2) / s.card → 0 ≤ V ∧ (V = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, x i = m)
